commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+9' Yellow card. Oliver Torres (Sevilla) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+7' 4 - 3 An absolutely stunning solo effort by Rafa Mir (Sevilla). He goes on a mazy run and unleashes a shot which goes into the top right corner. Fantastic finish!
90+6' Jesus Corona (Sevilla) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+4' Alaves take a short corner kick.
90+3' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) for a tough tackle.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.

90' Miguel de la Fuente (Alaves) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Marko Dmitrovic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Alaves win a corner.
87' Here is a change. Luis Rioja is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Miguel de la Fuente (Alaves).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rafa Marin is coming onto the pitch as Ruben Duarte (Alaves) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
85' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

84' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
84' Ander Guevara (Alaves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Sevilla will take a free kick.
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 13:10.
79' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Carlos Benavidez is replaced by Antonio Blanco (Alaves).
79' Mamadou Sylla (Alaves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kike Garcia.
77' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
76' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
75' Jose Luis Mendilibar has decided to substitute Suso and he is replaced by Rafa Mir (Sevilla).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jesus Corona (Sevilla) will replace Joan Jordan.
72' Fernando (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
70' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and it's Kike Garcia (Alaves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
67' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javi Lopez (Alaves) replacing Xeber Alkain.
67' Suso (Sevilla) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
66' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' The substitution is prepared. Oliver Torres (Sevilla) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lucas Ocampos.
59' 4 - 2 Goal - 4:2! Luis Rioja tees up Kike Garcia (Alaves) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Marko Dmitrovic.
58' Ander Guevara (Alaves) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Marko Dmitrovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
54' 3 - 2 Goal! Kike Garcia (Alaves) meets a headed pass from Jon Guridi and puts the ball into the net with a powerful header. He makes it 3:2.
51' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
49' A cross from Xeber Alkain (Alaves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' Half-time substitution. Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) will not participate anymore and Adria Pedrosa is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jose Luis Mendilibar gives a chance to Fernando and Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is off.
46' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+6' A cross into the box from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is cleared.

45+3' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) strikes a thunderbolt from a long-range free kick, but the effort goes well wide of the left post. It's going to be a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

44' 2 - 2 What a hit that is! Ruben Duarte (Alaves) displays his shooting ability as he slams the ball goalwards from distance. His brilliant effort goes towards the bottom left corner and bounces in off the post.

41' 1 - 2 Lucas Ocampos produces a killer pass to release Erik Lamela (Sevilla), who then unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 1:2!

40' Good chance! Xeber Alkain (Alaves) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
38' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
35' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) accepts a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot towards the goal, but he only hits the left post! What an unlucky moment for him.
31' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
30' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
29' Xeber Alkain (Alaves) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick to Sevilla.
28' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Joan Jordan (Sevilla).

26' Jon Guridi (Alaves) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
25' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
25' The ball is cleared after Jon Guridi (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Alaves will take a corner kick.

24' A nice lofted cross finds Kike Garcia (Alaves) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Kike Garcia (Alaves) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.
22' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. It's a throw-in for Sevilla.

20' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Guillermo Cuadra blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

18' Xeber Alkain (Alaves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
15' 1 - 1 OWN GOAL! Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 1:1.
15' Sevilla earn a corner.
14' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.

12' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
12' Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.

10' The cross into the penalty area from Erik Lamela (Sevilla) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Luis Rioja (Alaves) is teed up on the edge of the box by Jon Guridi, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
6' A pass by Xeber Alkain (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
4' Kike Garcia (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
3' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Sevilla will kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
